headline: Ways to work together

offers.title: Retained Advisory
offers.body:
The question that doesn't resolve in a quarter, held over months — working with the strategic decisions and the person making them.
Typically six months. Sessions weekly or fortnightly, with written exchange between.

offers.title: Deep Day
offers.body:
You're carrying one decision that everything else is waiting on. A day to see it fully — from the inside and the outside — and leave knowing your move.
Six to eight hours, at the studio or on location.

offers.title: Retreats in the Rheintal
offers.body: Small group retreats, a few times each year, in the Alpstein. A different setting for the thinking the desk doesn't make room for.

offers.title: Team Trainings & Workshops
offers.body: Custom trainings and workshops to serve the development of key skills and performance drivers in your team. On request. Contact me directly, moritz@lembertstudio.com

closing: Engagements are scoped to the question and what it's worth to resolve. We agree on that together before any proposal.
